title: Bear cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='10' fill='#a9703f'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='10' fill='#a9703f'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='5' fill='#e8b98a'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='5' fill='#e8b98a'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#c98a52'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f0cfa0'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4.5' ry='3.2' fill='#3a2418'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M43 53 Q50 58 57 53' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- scarf -->
    <path d='M26 62 Q50 72 74 62 L74 70 Q50 80 26 70 Z' fill='#e0473e'/>
    <path d='M26 62 Q50 72 74 62' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
    <!-- scarf tail -->
    <path d='M66 68 L74 88 L64 90 L60 70 Z' fill='#e0473e'/>
    <path d='M63 78 L72 76' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M64 84 L73 82' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#c98a52'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f0cfa0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
